📖 Executive Governance Handbook

🏛️

1. The Executive Desk

Each turn, review policy memorandums and choose an executive directive or advance without action to maintain current momentum.

👥

2. Faction Trust & Coalitions

Balance Military, Business, Public, and International trust. Severe erosion in any bloc's confidence risks strikes, capital flight, downgrades, or a coup d'état.

📈

3. Fiscal Solvency & Public Services

Maintain GDP growth and keep Debt-to-GDP under control. Deep debt triggers sovereign bond downgrades and punishing austerity.

⏱️

4. Delayed Systemic Consequences

Policy reforms unfold over 1–3 turns. Monitor the Pending Consequences panel on the right desk to prepare for delayed outcomes.

🏆

5. 20-Turn Mandate

Survive economic crises and political flashpoints across 20 turns to complete your administration and record your historical legacy in the Past Runs archive.
